workstreams.title: Close the cover-transfer arithmetic and certificate gaps
workstreams.summary: Retain the implemented general binary norm and declared-annihilator named-subgroup certificate, frozen 174-map/150-binding binary certificate corpus, direct-prime degree-two transfer core, exhaustive independent F5 Picard-class oracle, current draft cryptanalysis source-parity evidence, bounded independent GF(8) map oracle, balanced two-infinity arithmetic slice, and bounded transfer sweeper, while keeping final mirror CI/review, wide-prime and catalog-wide odd support, the remaining exact-order evidence, package replay, a fully independent binary source group law, and broader reference coverage as separate gated changes.

deliverables.description: Partial direct-prime degree-two transfer core for C: v^2=F(u^2+c) to a short-Weierstrass target over deterministically checked odd primes fitting 64 bits: balanced pullback, arbitrary balanced-class pushforward, deck action, both composition identities, and bounded independent Fp2 pointwise norm checks. An exhaustive independent F5 Picard-class oracle now checks all 36 classes, the complete 36-by-36 group table, exceptional cases, and both transfer compositions. Larger primes, normalized targets, extension fields, nonsplit infinity, and catalog-wide replay remain unsupported or unverified.

Implemented arbitrary-class binary Jacobian pushforward/norm and elliptic-image projector for checked cubic covers, including nonsplit support, plus a named-generator certificate that proves injectivity and degree-inverse recovery only from a checked declared annihilator coprime to degree three. The implementation makes no exact-order or primality claim. Draft cryptanalysis revision cd509d3b6a8b9599f8b975dc8692d772264e5ce4 records source parity with crypto revision 6cb5ab1edb141b48b9a9767fc63fe95ba1aac217 and separately pins the corpus producer/containing revisions; final mirror CI/review, independent source-group arithmetic, and package replay remain gated.

Frozen 498,477-byte binary certificate corpus produced at crypto revision c01ba3960ada49d73e2c48acb0e175f9e77e1680 with recorded producer-source SHA-256 32ca4682a05dfe5a2dca7a6b1f50d2df7f5a589a6dbd68252516e7935af5da47. It retains all 174 map records and 150 named bindings with zero failed records; 102 bindings have proved exact-order evidence and 48 remain unknown. It certifies only the recorded binary named generated subgroups and explicitly supplies no solver or computational-advantage assessment.

Independent F5 Picard-class oracle for y^2=x^6+1 that constructs its own 36-class group law from projective functions, checks the complete 36-by-36 group table, exceptional/shared-support cases, target arithmetic, and both transfer compositions. The separate bounded GF(8) oracle still uses production source-Jacobian addition, so the combined cross-characteristic independence gate remains partial.

acceptance_gates.scope: Balanced two-infinity arithmetic and degree-two induced maps cover the exact 22,243-map, 940-representation odd population at the 2026-11-18 live registry snapshot: 20,808 direct-prime maps/909 representations, 30 normalized-prime maps/22 representations, and 1,405 extension maps/9 representations, with exact membership hashes, exhaustive supported small-field checks, exceptional-divisor tests, and an independent oracle.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The balanced backend and direct-prime transfer core handle monic squarefree degree-six genus-two split models over deterministically checked odd primes fitting 64 bits, with direct short-Weierstrass degree-two maps and both composition identities. The independent F5 oracle exhausts all 36 classes and all 1,296 ordered sums for one split-sextic fixture, including exceptional cases and both transfer compositions. The implementation and oracle do not cover larger primes, extension fields, nonsplit infinity, normalized-model maps, or the complete 22,243-row population. The bounded candidate sweeper likewise does not close this gate.

acceptance_gates.scope: A catalog-general binary norm handles every valid reduced class for all 174 binary cubic map rows and 150 representations at the 2026-11-18 live registry snapshot, including shared, nonsplit, repeated, and exceptional support, verifies degree-three composition, exports exact EC1/ICV1/HC1/CV1 bindings and certificates, and has a current cryptanalysis mirror/integration receipt.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The native implementation handles arbitrary valid reduced classes for checked binary cubic covers and certifies degree-three composition and projectors, including exhaustive GF(8) and exact n=83 checks. It also checks named-generator injectivity and degree-inverse recovery when a declared annihilator is coprime to three, without claiming that every declared annihilator is the exact or prime order. The frozen corpus at SHA-256 93150649c0754adb1ca50d74fa4419df9a77c98b156e75e33084a9f31f656ce8 retains all 174 maps and 150 named bindings with zero failures, 102 proved exact-order records, and 48 unknown records. Draft cryptanalysis revision cd509d3b6a8b9599f8b975dc8692d772264e5ce4 is parity-bound to crypto revision 6cb5ab1edb141b48b9a9767fc63fe95ba1aac217 and records the crypto-owned producer/corpus revisions; focused parity and arithmetic tests pass, but final mirror CI and review remain open. The bounded sweeper is not an enumeration of all transfers. The separate GF(8) oracle uses production source-Jacobian addition. Independent binary source-law replay, package replay, and any solver advantage remain open.

acceptance_gates.scope: All 1,090 exact EC1/curve/map bindings at the 2026-11-18 live snapshot have exact order, image, kernel-intersection, composition, and recovery evidence: 150 binary degree-three bindings and 940 odd degree-two bindings, with separate membership hashes.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The frozen binary corpus establishes injectivity and recovery for all 150 recorded named generated subgroups under checked coprime declared annihilators, with zero failed records. It records proved exact-order evidence for 102 bindings and explicitly leaves 48 unknown; those unknown orders, all 940 odd bindings, exact image orders, kernel intersections beyond the recorded claim scope, and independent all-live replay remain open. Generator-level evidence does not establish every required all-element or exact-order claim.

acceptance_gates.scope: A mathematically independent implementation or pinned CAS agrees on all 486 fixed-GF(8) classes and their transfer identities, plus an exhaustive balanced genus-two fixture over an odd prime at most 31, including exceptional and shared-support cases.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The independent F5 oracle constructs and exhaustively checks a complete 36-class Picard group law and both transfer compositions without production balanced arithmetic, reduction, scalar multiplication, or target group law. This satisfies the odd-fixture portion for one exact curve only. The bounded GF(8) map-value oracle still uses production source-Jacobian addition, so no qualifying independent binary source group law is attached and the combined gate remains open.

non_claims: A cover or transfer does not establish a faster destination solver.
A bounded candidate sweeper does not enumerate all mathematical transfers, and an empty bounded result is not a nonexistence proof.

The full Jacobian index-calculus solver is a separate deliverable with actual relations, checked linear algebra and target decomposition, independent output verification, explicit parameters, and total resource accounting.

dependencies.rationale: Current cover evidence and package identity must be stable before broad arithmetic applicability promotion.
Arithmetic, map, subgroup, and solver claims need separate evidence profiles.
Evidence profiles require stable unit and assessment identities.
Taxonomy cells require exact units and frozen denominators.
Each route needs a route-specific evidence profile.
The route freeze must be grounded in a cited, searched public corpus.
Claims and sources need stable content-addressed identities.
The corpus supplies and revises taxonomy candidates without creating a blocking cycle.
Run receipts bind exact units, implementations, and evidence revisions.
Cost claims are promoted through explicit evidence gates.
Governance decisions refer to immutable assessment identities.
Governance enforces evidence transitions and corrections.
Performance review requires the shared accounting contract.
Current cover evidence promotion uses the independent review roles.
Cover arithmetic and subgroup claims require independent role review.
Taxonomy completeness and route findings are approved separately.
Corpus inclusion, provenance, and comparator decisions are reviewable.

governance.promotion_rule: A claim is promoted only when every profile-required evidence gate, authorization gate, exact revision binding, semantic check, and independent role approval passes.
governance.correction_rule: Corrections append a superseding assessment and preserve old evidence, decisions, and denominators; they never rewrite the frozen record.
